playthrough_notes: Super Mario All-Stars consists of four separate classic games: Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, Super Mario Bros. 2, and Super Mario Bros. 3. Each game features dedicated quests, speedrun challenges, and character trials.
settings_notes: Standard SNES controls with battery-backed save files per game. Save states are disabled in Hardcore mode.

missables.label: World 9 Warpless Requirement (Lost Levels)
missables.deadline: Must reach and complete World 8-4 without using any Warp Zones in Worlds 1 through 8

missables.label: SMB1 Shortest Route Speedrun
missables.deadline: Beat SMB1 in a single session from a fresh file using 1-2 and 4-2 warp zones

missables.label: SMB1 Steadfast Platformer (Deathless)
missables.deadline: Beat SMB1 from a fresh file in one session without losing a single life

missables.label: SMBTLL Shortest Route Speedrun
missables.deadline: Beat SMB The Lost Levels from a fresh file in one session using optimal warp routes

missables.label: SMB2 Nightmare-Free Journey (Deathless World)
missables.deadline: Clear an entire world in SMB2 without losing a single life

missables.label: SMB2 Mario-Only Warpless Run
missables.deadline: Complete all 20 stages without warps selecting only Mario for every single stage

missables.label: SMB2 Princess Peach-Only Warpless Run
missables.deadline: Complete all 20 stages without warps selecting only Princess Peach for every single stage

missables.label: SMB2 Toad-Only Warpless Run
missables.deadline: Complete all 20 stages without warps selecting only Toad for every single stage

missables.label: SMB2 Luigi-Only Warpless Run
missables.deadline: Complete all 20 stages without warps selecting only Luigi for every single stage

missables.label: SMB2 Super Speedrun Bros. 2 (8 Stages Max)
missables.deadline: Beat SMB2 clearing at most 8 stages using vase warps in 1-3 and 4-2

missables.label: SMB2 Sweet Dreams (Single Session Deathless)
missables.deadline: Beat the entire game in a single sitting without losing a life

missables.label: SMB3 Super Speedrun Bros. 3 (Shortest Route)
missables.deadline: Complete SMB3 in one session using the shortest route via Warp Whistles

ponr.label: Point of No Return: SMB1 Final Castle Bridge
ponr.warning: Once you trigger Bowser falling into the lava in World 8-4, you cannot backtrack to earlier worlds on the first quest.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: SMB1 Star Course World 8-4 Bridge
ponr.warning: Triggering the bridge axe in Star Course World 8-4 concludes the Second Quest.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: Lost Levels World 8-4 Bridge
ponr.warning: Defeating Bowser in World 8-4 checks your warp history; if warps were taken, the game loops to World 1 instead of World 9.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: Lost Levels World D-4 Chamber
ponr.warning: Defeating the final Bowser in Stage D-4 concludes the secret worlds campaign.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: Wart Throne Room Door
ponr.warning: Entering the throne room in World 7-2 locks the entrance behind you for the final confrontation against Wart.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: SMB2 Speedrun Wart Entry
ponr.warning: Entering Wart’s inner sanctum seals your run; ensure your stage clear count is 8 or fewer before entering.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: Sea Side Airship Departure
ponr.warning: Defeating Wendy O. Koopa on the Sea Side airship sends Mario forward to World 4, making earlier map panels inaccessible without warps.

ponr.label: Point of No Return: Bowser Citadel Throne Room Door
ponr.warning: Entering the grand chamber in World 8 Castle of Koopa begins the final battle against Bowser.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. — First Quest (Worlds 1–8)
chapters.notes: Journey through the 8 classic worlds of the Mushroom Kingdom in Super Mario Bros., finding warp zones, coin rooms, and collecting power-ups.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. — Second Quest & Speedrun
chapters.notes: Conquer the harder Star Courses (Second Quest) where Goombas become Buzzy Beetles and platforms are shorter, plus deathless and shortest-route speedruns.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels — Main Quest (Worlds 1–8)
chapters.notes: Survive the punishing original Japanese sequel. Important: do not use any warps if you wish to access World 9!

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels — Secret Worlds (Worlds 9 & A–D)
chapters.notes: Explore the surreal bonus World 9 (unlocked by beating Worlds 1-8 warpless) and the post-game Worlds A through D.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. 2 — Subcon Liberation (Worlds 1–7)
chapters.notes: Pluck vegetables, enter Subspace, and defeat Wart and his 8th-in-command bosses without taking damage in the dream world of Subcon.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. 2 — Character Mastery & Speedrun
chapters.notes: Clear the game warpless using exclusively Mario, Luigi, Toad, and Princess Peach, along with deathless and 8-stage speedrun restrictions.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. 3 — Grass Land to Sea Side (Worlds 1–3)
chapters.notes: Journey through the first three kingdoms of Super Mario Bros. 3, mastering minigames, White Mushroom Houses, and Warp Whistles.

chapters.title: Super Mario Bros. 3 — Giant Land to Dark Land (Worlds 4–8)
chapters.notes: Conquer Worlds 4 through 8, amass inventory items, and defeat Bowser in his heavily fortified Dark Land fortress.

categories.name: Super Mario Bros. 100% Mastery
categories.description: Clear all 8 worlds of First Quest and all 8 worlds of Second Quest (Star Course), discover all underground coin rooms, and master deathless and speedrun challenges.

categories.name: The Lost Levels Complete Conquest
categories.description: Complete Worlds 1 through 8 warpless to unlock and beat World 9 (Fantasy World), accumulate 8 game clears to unlock Worlds A through D, and conquer all secret worlds.

categories.name: Super Mario Bros. 2 Subcon Liberation
categories.description: Complete all 20 stages warpless with each individual character (Mario, Peach, Toad, Luigi), uncover Subspace mushroom health upgrades, and defeat Wart deathless.

categories.name: Super Mario Bros. 3 Comprehensive Mastery
categories.description: Conquer all 8 main worlds, find all 3 Warp Whistles, trigger all White Mushroom Houses, spawn Treasure Ships, and breach Bowser Castle in Dark Land.

chapter_checkpoints: SMB1 First Quest Completion & Secret Rooms
SMBTLL Warpless Run & World 9 Fantasy World
SMB3 Worlds 4-8 Dark Land & Bowser Defeat
